title: Continually learning neural-operator surrogate for three-dimensional airborne electromagnetic Bayesian inversion
abstract: arXiv:2608.25932v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Three-dimensional probabilistic inversion of time-domain airborne electromagnetic (AEM) data is limited by the cost of the forward solve. Even though one simulation takes only tens of seconds, a Bayesian inversion of a survey of millions of soundings requires of order $10^{10}$ forward evaluations. To address this, we develop a continually learning neural-operator surrogate of the three-dimensional AEM forward operator that replaces the solver inside the Bayesian inversion. We start from the point of view that regardless of what geological prior is specified, Maxwell's laws remain invariant. Secondly, we avoid the limitation of learning on a single prior by continual learning on consecutive priors, which means our surrogate becomes richer as it is applied in future case studies, either by the authors, or by the scientific community. translated_title: 连续学习神经算子代理用于三维航空电磁贝叶斯反演
translated_abstract: 摘要：三维时域航空电磁（AEM）数据的概率反演受正演求解成本限制。尽管单次模拟仅需数十秒，但对包含数百万测点的测区进行贝叶斯反演需要约10^10次正演评估。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一个连续学习的神经算子代理，用于替代贝叶斯反演中的三维AEM正演算子。我们首先从这样的观点出发：无论指定何种地质先验，麦克斯韦定律保持不变。其次，我们通过对连续先验进行持续学习来避免在单一先验上学习的局限性，这意味着我们的代理在未来的案例研究中（无论是作者还是科学界使用）会变得更加丰富。我们使用基于集成不一致性的有效性检查，将测量值超出范围的案例分流。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种通过连续学习神经算子代理替代三维航空电磁正演求解器的方法，利用麦克斯韦定律不变性和多先验持续学习，显著降低贝叶斯反演的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a continually learning neural-operator surrogate to replace the 3D airborne electromagnetic forward solver, leveraging Maxwell's law invariance and continual learning across priors to significantly reduce Bayesian inversion computational cost.
